title: Trump's team says 'no children' died from USAID cuts. Consider these 3 cases
summary: Both Marco Rubio and Elon Musk, who led the effort to sunset the foreign aid agency, have said that no deaths have been linked to the cutting of its funding. These parents tell a different story.
contentText:
